description: The plot illustrates how perplexity varies with the parameter \(M\) for three models. The x-axis is labeled “M” on a linear scale, spanning values from 3 to 8 with ticks at each integer. The y-axis is labeled “Perplexity” on a linear scale, ranging from about 15 to 40 with labeled ticks at 20, 30, and 40. The LLaMA1-7B series is shown as a green solid line with circular markers, starting near 28 at \(M=3\), decreasing to about 25 at \(M=4\) and about 24.5 at \(M=5\), then rising to roughly 27 at \(M=6\), about 31 at \(M=7\), and ending near 36 at \(M=8\). The LLaMA1-13B series is shown as an orange solid line with star markers, starting around 20 at \(M=3\), dropping to about 16.5 at \(M=4\), staying near 16 at \(M=5\) and \(M=6\), then increasing to about 17 at \(M=7\) and returning to around 20 at \(M=8\). The Vicuna-7B series is shown as a blue solid line with upward triangle markers, beginning near 41 at \(M=3\), decreasing to about 35.5 at \(M=4\) and about 34.5 at \(M=5\), remaining around 34 at \(M=6\), then rising slightly to about 34.5 at \(M=7\) and ending near 39.5 at \(M=8\).
